title: Strategic Integration of Artificial Intelligence in the C-Suite: The Role of the Chief AI Officer
abstract: arXiv:2407.10247v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into corporate strategy has become critical for organizations seeking to maintain competitive advantage in the digital age. Although organizations increasingly rely on AI as a strategic and organizational resource, existing C-suite roles remain only partially equipped to govern, integrate, and leverage it coherently at the enterprise level. Organizations vary in their responses. Some create a dedicated Chief AI Officer (CAIO), others extend existing mandates into hybrid roles, and still others coordinate AI through federated structures. This paper develops a role-design theory to explain this variation. translated_title: 人工智能在高管层的战略整合：首席人工智能官的角色
translated_abstract: 将人工智能整合到企业战略中，对于在数字时代寻求保持竞争优势的组织而言已变得至关重要。尽管组织日益将AI作为战略性和组织性资源加以依赖，但现有的高管层角色仍只能部分胜任在企业层面对其进行治理、整合和运用的任务。组织的应对方式各不相同：一些组织设立专门的首席人工智能官（CAIO），另一些将现有职责扩展为混合型角色，还有一些通过联邦式结构来协调AI。本文构建了一种角色设计理论来解释这种差异。我识别出AI系统区别于以往横跨性企业技术的三个特性——判断责任的分散性、上游治理性和非平稳性，以及组织应对的三种配置：集中延伸型、分……
tldr: 本文提出一种角色设计理论，通过识别AI区别于传统企业技术的三个特性（判断责任分散、上游治理和非平稳性），解释了组织为何采用专门首席人工智能官、混合角色或联邦结构等不同配置来在企业层面治理和整合AI。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a role-design theory that identifies three distinctive properties of AI systems—distributed accountability for judgment, upstream governance, and non-stationarity—to explain why organizations adopt different configurations, such as dedicated Chief AI Officers, hybrid roles, or federated structures, for governing AI at the enterprise level.
